periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at a lateral-inferior angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal midline of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-shaped with distinct vertical elongation and a tapering inferior margin.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward elongation where the lowest point of the patch is noticeably further from the eye than the superior boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The black shoulder region occupies approximately 40 percent of the vertical torso height before transitioning to the white ventral fur.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral set with a gap approximately equal to 1.5 times the horizontal width of an individual pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible lower dentition including incisors and canines due to open-mouth posture; ventral fur displays heavy brownish-yellow chromatic staining compared to the white facial fur.
